notes.title: Machick 2 + Machick Mayhen Update
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone!!! We’re back with some huge news, and we couldn’t be more excited to finally share it with you. The Machick universe is officially expanding!
[/p][h3]The chickens are back in style, and things are about to get wild:
[/h3][previewyoutube="5hvZmvvWjfs;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
• The long-awaited sequel [i]Machick 2[/i] arrives on [b]September 10[/b], opening the doors to a brand-new chapter of magical chaos — more wands to craft, stranger frogs to face, powerful relics to collect, absurd fusions to discover, and plenty of surprises along the way. The Demo is already live on Steam, so you can jump in right now — and don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist to join us on day one![/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3449040/Machick_2" style="button"]Wishlist Machick 2[/url][/p][p] • But that’s not all. [i]Machick 1[/i] still has plenty of news on the way, and we’ve been secretly working on new content for all of you who love the original game. The first major update, called [b]Chicken Mayhen[/b], is set to launch later this year, bringing fresh chaos and challenges — with even more updates already planned for 2026![/p][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44861814/db19d734b6a63fab9e215a8650c0daa4b1f3abdf.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44861814/af3f8361f86ef4e2e0551b1796bf0ec7982ffdef.gif"][/img]
• Behind the scenes, we’ve been balancing two crazy missions: building [i]Machick 2[/i] from the ground up and at the same time ensuring [i]Machick 1[/i] continues to get the attention and love it deserves. It’s been a lot of work, but it’s also been an amazing journey.[/p][p][/p][p]• We can’t thank you enough for your support — every bit of feedback, every wishlist, every run played has helped shape this universe. Machick only exists because of you, and we’re so excited to bring you this next wave of magical madness.[/p][p][/p][h1]Get ready, because this is just the beginning.[/h1][p align="start"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44861814/1946252265013df68a613abbe142300ec5393eb3.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Colder and Colder
notes.content:
Hey everyone!!! We’re back! We’ve launched Bees Vs Zombees and we’re preparing an even larger sequel to Machick. And for this winter, we’ve put together a Christmas update, featuring a new map, bug fixes you’ve reported to us, and balance adjustments to wands and enemies.

Fixes and Improvements:  
- Adjusted enemy behavior that previously wandered aimlessly, ensuring a more coherent movement pattern.  
- Fixed the Satellite Skill so it now deals damage correctly.  
- Optimized the Satellite Skill, removing errors and improving performance (FPS) during use.  
- Enhanced the Gas Skill for better overall performance.  
- Reduced resource gathering time, making gameplay more dynamic.  
- Updated shop prices for a more consistent purchasing experience.  
- Fixed the Auto Aim so it no longer turns off unexpectedly.  
- Adjusted the chicken’s animation frames interpolation, ensuring smoother transitions.  
- Reduced damage dealt by the Spectral Boss to balance combat difficulty.  
- Made the Shard Chest more stable, addressing previously unpredictable behavior.  
- Fixed a critical bug causing crashes, resulting in improved stability.  
- Enemies will no longer remain on fire after returning to the enemy “pool.”  
- Enemies will not retain the slowdown effect after returning to the “pool,” avoiding unintended permanent status effects.

New Content:  
- Added a new winter-themed map called “Pepitas,” featuring a chilly setting and new challenges.  
- Introduced the Santa Chicken, a festive new character to brighten your adventure.

We’re preparing even more beyond this update for the future, and we hope you continue to enjoy the game and interact with our team on Discord. Any ideas for additions are welcome, so feel free to get in touch!

If you have any suggestions for new features in the game, feel free to share them on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/e7U4s2yGdB]Discord[/url].

notes.title: Patch Note: Huge optimizations and Critical bug fixes

Hello everyone! We appreciate all who have sent in their feedback. With that, we've been able to identify and address many performance and progression issues within the game. We apologize to players who had a poor experience. Our aim is to deliver a better experience now with these updates and those to come.

We're opening a Discord server for quicker interaction and to share what we're working on.

https://discord.gg/e7U4s2yGdB

notes.title: Patch Note: 04/13/2024 New Progression e New Contents
notes.content:
Hello everyone!! We want to thank you for the support you've been giving to the game, writing feedback to make it better and better. In the past few weeks, we've implemented many new mechanics, focusing mainly on the game's progression. I hope you enjoy the improvements we've made and feel free to write us feedback and bug reports that are happening.

Additions:
- 5 new enemies
- 2 types of bosses + 3 variants
- 2 new maps
- 4 new powerups
- 5 buff items
- 6 unique boss powerups
- Can use rerolling relics
- Destructible obstacles
- Auto resolution correction
- Animation in selection menus
- Korean language
- Auto Aim
- Compass

Improvements:
- Player HUD reworked
- Improved HUB
- Progression between maps completely altered
- Special wands reworked
- Improvements in sound clarity
- Screens for cards, relics, and fragments improved
- Fixed scrolling quantity instead of using money
- End game screen changed
- Reworked powerup VFX
- Objects remain in the store after being purchased
- Material effect descriptions during craft
- Chests with reworked visuals and effects
- Rebalanced coin drop
- Rebalanced store prices
- Redone compass
- Reduced lifespan of coins and XP

For those asking for controller support, in this update, we've added controller support for most of the game mechanics, but the support is still not 100%. We appreciate everyone's patience, and as soon as possible, we'll have full support so you can enjoy the game without the need for a keyboard and mouse.

notes.title: Patch Note: 03/29/2024 Performance and features
notes.content: Hey guys, for now, I'm just coming here to thank all of you who've sent us feedback, and to inform you that we've fixed the FPS drop that made the game impossible to play. Additionally, we've rolled out the auto-aim feature and a few other improvements. Tomorrow, we'll update this note with all the things we've updated!

notes.title: Patch Note: 03/27/2024 - Performance

We're also tweaking some flashy effects and cutting down on the stuff cluttering up the screen, so the next update should run a lot smoother.
